snippet.title: Rogue Snake - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Rogue Snake is the latest evolution of the classical snake game. We've added combat and roguelite mechanics - earn levels, upgrade your Mecha Snake and defeat bosses while dodging enemy attacks!

Steam - store.steampowered.com/app/3207150/Rogue_Snake/
